programme.title: Rääkiv Tom ja supertiim
programme.desc: Rääkiv Tom ja ta sõbrad Angela, Ben ja Hank avastavad müstilise seadeldise, mis annab neile imelised võimed ja teeb neist superkangelased. Nüüd on nad varustatud vingete võimete ja vajalike vidinatega ning on valmis kaitsma oma linna kõigi hädade ja kurjamite eest koos oma ustavate sõprade Rääkiva Becca ja Rääkiva Gingeriga. Kahjuks tuleb välja, et superkangelane olemise jaoks ei ole käsiraamatut, seega peavad nad koos oma tegelikud võimed avastama ja maailma päästma!

programme.title: Gabby nukumaja
programme.desc: Killuke maagiat ja nukumaja saadetis aitavad meil avastada koos Gabby ja tema kiisusõpradega fantastilist nukumaja. Gabby on positiivne ja otsusekindel 11aastane tüdruk, kes ei pelga ebatäiuslikkust ning kasutab tehtud vigasid enda arendamiseks. Ta parim sõber Pandakass Pandi on alati tema kõrval, naeratus suul ja paunas suupiste, et koos seigelda. Ühine nende ja teiste Gabby kassidega põnevatel seiklustel ning mängi, meisterda, tantsi ja avasta uusi asju iga päev!

programme.desc: Poli on väike politseiauto, kes suudab muutuda robotiks. Kui nende linnas juhtub mistahes õnnetus, lähevad vaprad päästemasinad inimestele alati appi.

programme.title: Rääkiv Tom ja supertiim
programme.desc: Rääkiv Tom ja ta sõbrad Angela, Ben ja Hank avastavad müstilise seadeldise, mis annab neile imelised võimed ja teeb neist superkangelased. Nüüd on nad varustatud vingete võimete ja vajalike vidinatega ning on valmis kaitsma oma linna kõigi hädade ja kurjamite eest koos oma ustavate sõprade Rääkiva Becca ja Rääkiva Gingeriga. Kahjuks tuleb välja, et superkangelane olemise jaoks ei ole käsiraamatut, seega peavad nad koos oma tegelikud võimed avastama ja maailma päästma!

programme.desc: "Printsess-rüütel Nella" on Briti-Ameerika animasari lõbu armastava ja kartmatu printsess Nella seiklusrohkest elust. Nella muutub rüütliks, kui on vaja oma kuningriiki kaitsta. Tema tähtsaim aare pole kroon, vaid armastatud sõbrad - ükssarvik Trinket, täkk Clod ja Sir Garret. Nella hooltiseb et tema sõprade ja kuningriigi teiste alamatega midagi ei juhtuks. Koos on neil lõbus, nag lahendavad mõistatusi ja võidavad raskusi, ilma millega on elu võimatu isegi kõige õnnelikumas kuningriigis.

programme.title: Деревенский детектив
programme.desc: Фильм по одноимённому роману Виля Липатова. В самой тихой деревне района ЧП - у заведующего клуба украли аккордеон. Улик преступники не оставили, свидетелей тоже. И заподозрить в воровстве некого - в деревне все свои. Завхоз махнул рукой и уже надумал новый аккордеон покупать. Но участковый Анискин всерьез собрался распутать это тёмное дело...

programme.title: Начать сначала
programme.desc: Самый крутой тренер по регби, известный своими жёсткими методами воспитания и регулярными запоями, отстранён от сборной. Он возвращается в родной город и решает начать сначала - хотя бы с учителя физкультуры. Однако, его преданность самому джентльменскому виду спорта, приводит к тому, что старшеклассники, которые в жизни терпеть друг друга не могут, превращаются в команду. Они готовы на любые испытания, чтобы освоить регби и отправиться покорять вершины спорта...

programme.title: Сказки Гофмана
programme.desc: Начало 2000-х. Неприметная девушка Надежда Страхова, как ни странно, замужем. Муж её, Виталик, провинциал, женился на бездетной Надежде ради московской прописки и типовой \"хрущёвки\" на окраине Москвы. Надежда работает на двух работах, чтобы содержать свою маленькую семью: по утрам в районной библиотеке и вечерами в театральном гардеробе. Однажды её жизнь резко меняется. Хозяин очередного пальто оказывается из мира рекламы и кино. Он замечает, что у Надежды очень красивые руки с невероятной пластикой. Это неожиданно меняет жизнь Надежды самым радикальным образом.

programme.title: Анискин и Фантомас
programme.desc: Телевизионный детектив по мотивам произведений В. Липатова об умном, внешне простоватом, добродушном сельском участковом Анискине, раскрывающем любые преступления. Злоумышленники в черных масках-чулках ограбили сельского кассира. Расследование ведет старший лейтенант Анискин. Он полагает, что местные дети чересчур увлеклись игрой во французского злодея Фантомаса. Но кто задумал ограбление, кто подбил детей на это преступление в сибирской глубинке, где все друг друга знают?

programme.title: Дублёр
programme.desc: Игорь Успенский - успешный актер, звезда шоу-бизнеса. Его жизнь - сплошные съемки, концерты, презентации, корпоративы, интервью и светские тусовки. Он вынужден \"крутиться\" день и ночь, у него нет выходных и праздников. В подмосковном городе живет Сева, человек, чрезвычайно похожий на Игоря Успенского. Он работает массажистом в салоне красоты, живет вдвоем с собакой по имени Сергей Валерьевич, абсолютно доволен своей жизнью и не признает сходства со звездой. Но однажды Игорь Успенский узнает о существовании своего двойника...

programme.title: (Не)искусственный интеллект
programme.desc: Во время экскурсии в научно-исследовательском центре 17-летний студент- первокурсник Женя случайно попадает в испытательный образец новой модели робота \"Апостол\" (A.P.O100L), обладающего собственной волей и разумом. Получив случайного пилота, машина берет управление на себя и принимает решение сбежать из лаборатории. Теперь, чтобы вернуться домой, Жене придется найти с искусственным интеллектом общий язык.

programme.title: Добро пожаловать в семью
programme.desc: Владимир Сычев, Светлана Камынина, Пётр Буслов, Кристина Строителева, Вячеслав Морозов, Ростислав Бершауэр, Алексей Маслодудов, Юлия Топольницкая, Торнике Квитатиани, Сергей Иванюк Красавица Мира - любимая дочь могущественного и грозного авторитета Леонида Ивановича. Все потенциальные ухажёры обходят её стороной, чтобы не навлечь на себя гнев "крестного отца". Все, кроме Саши, который влюбляется в Миру, ничего не подозревая о её семье…

programme.title: Ученик
programme.desc: Нью-Йорк, начало 1970-х. Дональд Трамп, младший сын девелопера недвижимости, ориентированной на средний класс, знакомится с адвокатом Роем Коном, который известен жёсткими методами и не проиграл ни одного дела. Компания Трампов обвиняется в расовой дискриминации и сдаче квартир преимущественно белым, поэтому Дональду очень пригодились бы полезные связи. Рой берёт молодого бизнесмена под своё крыло и, шантажируя судью, выигрывает дело.

programme.title: Купи меня
programme.desc: Три подруги-студентки, вырвавшись из-под родительской опеки, мечтают о красивой жизни. На молодость и красоту всегда есть спрос, так почему бы этим не воспользоваться? Дорогие машины, богатые "папики", ночные клубы, секс без любви… Смогут ли девчонки осуществить свои мечты о красивой жизни?

programme.title: Нулевой километр
programme.desc: История о двух молодых ребятах, которые приехали \"покорять Москву\". Целеустремленный Костя мечтает стать клипмейкером. Пронырливый Олег видит свой успех в солидном материальном достатке. Оба получают шанс воплотить свои мечты в реальность, но любовь с первого взгляда, вспыхнувшая между Костей и очаровательной молодой балериной Алиной, вытрясает из шкафов столько скелетов, что легкая мелодрама превращается в триллер с элементами боевика. Предать и простить предательство, стать невольным убийцей и спастись от верной смерти, добиться главного в жизни шанса, и принести этот шанс в жертву любви - вот ставки по которым придется играть нашим героям.

programme.title: Анискин и Фантомас
programme.desc: Телевизионный детектив по мотивам произведений В. Липатова об умном, внешне простоватом, добродушном сельском участковом Анискине, раскрывающем любые преступления. programme.title: Давай разведемся!
programme.desc: В любви все средства хороши, особенно, если любовь нужно вернуть... Успешный врач Маша поглощена работой и не сразу замечает, что от нее уходит муж Миша. Жизнь переворачивается вверх дном: на работе аврал, дети требуют постоянного внимания, а привыкшая побеждать Маша не готова уступить любимого мужа красотке фитнес-тренеру Оксане. Силы, конечно, неравны. Марии уже прилично за тридцать, а сопернице совсем немного после двадцати. Но, с другой стороны, за Машиной спиной богатый жизненный опыт и двое малолетних детей. В этой ситуации она готова использовать весь свой боевой арсенал, включая потусторонние силы. К тому же новая жизнь открывает новые возможности… Комедийная мелодрама, Россия, 2019 г. Режиссеры: А.Пармас В ролях: А.Михалкова, А.Филипенко, А.Рыцарева, М.Лагашкин, С.Камынина, Ф.Лавров, Н.Маркина, М.Скородумова, М.Бурмистров, О.Альбанова

programme.title: Одна жизнь
programme.desc: Скромного и непубличного джентльмена Николаса Уинтона приглашают на телевизионное ток-шоу, где он наконец-то узнает всю правду о событиях Второй мировой войны, когда он пытался спасти сотни детей от гибели в концлагере. Одна жизнь может изменить судьбы сотен людей — как в прошлом, так и в настоящем.

programme.title: Суходол
programme.desc: Это история Натальи, молодой и наивной девушки-крестьянки служащей в обедневшей дворянской семье в их деревенском поместье. Наталья не знает другой жизни, ее голова полна суеверий и страхов, но ее душа — душа героини. Через перипетии ее жизни: любовь, преданность хозяевам, мистический опыт, изгнание, предательство, веру, мы наблюдаем и то, как роковым образом складывается судьба семьи Хрущевых, в которой Наталья служит.

programme.title: Добро пожаловать в семью
programme.desc: Владимир Сычев, Светлана Камынина, Пётр Буслов, Кристина Строителева, Вячеслав Морозов, Ростислав Бершауэр, Алексей Маслодудов, Юлия Топольницкая, Торнике Квитатиани, Сергей Иванюк Красавица Мира - любимая дочь могущественного и грозного авторитета Леонида Ивановича. Все потенциальные ухажёры обходят её стороной, чтобы не навлечь на себя гнев "крестного отца". Все, кроме Саши, который влюбляется в Миру, ничего не подозревая о её семье…

programme.title: Ученик
programme.desc: Нью-Йорк, начало 1970-х. Дональд Трамп, младший сын девелопера недвижимости, ориентированной на средний класс, знакомится с адвокатом Роем Коном, который известен жёсткими методами и не проиграл ни одного дела. Компания Трампов обвиняется в расовой дискриминации и сдаче квартир преимущественно белым, поэтому Дональду очень пригодились бы полезные связи. Рой берёт молодого бизнесмена под своё крыло и, шантажируя судью, выигрывает дело.

programme.title: И снова Анискин
programme.desc: Из деревенского музея украли самые ценные экспонаты, к великому сожалению его директора и реставратора, художника Бережкова, приехавшего вместе с женой из города. О преступнике известно, что это мужчина высокого роста и с большим размером обуви. Среди подозрительных лиц имеются грубые и несознательные шабашники, строящие силосную башню; отставший от парохода матрос-пьяница; местный алкоголик, своего рода последний из могикан; Верка-Косая и некий Сидоров. За всеми шпионит помешавшийся на детективах Лютиков. Кто же обокрал музей?

programme.title: Давай разведемся!
programme.desc: В любви все средства хороши, особенно, если любовь нужно вернуть... Успешный врач Маша поглощена работой и не сразу замечает, что от нее уходит муж Миша. Жизнь переворачивается вверх дном: на работе аврал, дети требуют постоянного внимания, а привыкшая побеждать Маша не готова уступить любимого мужа красотке фитнес-тренеру Оксане. Силы, конечно, неравны. Марии уже прилично за тридцать, а сопернице совсем немного после двадцати. Но, с другой стороны, за Машиной спиной богатый жизненный опыт и двое малолетних детей. В этой ситуации она готова использовать весь свой боевой арсенал, включая потусторонние силы. К тому же новая жизнь открывает новые возможности… Комедийная мелодрама, Россия, 2019 г. Режиссеры: А.Пармас В ролях: А.Михалкова, А.Филипенко, А.Рыцарева, М.Лагашкин, С.Камынина, Ф.Лавров, Н.Маркина, М.Скородумова, М.Бурмистров, О.Альбанова

programme.title: Одна жизнь
programme.desc: Скромного и непубличного джентльмена Николаса Уинтона приглашают на телевизионное ток-шоу, где он наконец-то узнает всю правду о событиях Второй мировой войны, когда он пытался спасти сотни детей от гибели в концлагере. Одна жизнь может изменить судьбы сотен людей — как в прошлом, так и в настоящем.

programme.title: Знакомство родителей
programme.desc: Перспективный сообразительный парень Федор, который вырос в детдоме и всего добился сам, влюбляется в девушку из богатой семьи. Однако ее родственники не в восторге от избранника из-за социального статуса и сомнительной родословной парня. Они заявляют, что дадут свое согласие только в том случае, если познакомятся с родителями жениха. Для Федора, который никогда не видел своих маму и папу, это условие кажется невыполнимым. Однако он готов на все ради любви.

programme.title: Страна глухих
programme.desc: Рита вынуждена скрываться: её друг Алёша исчез, проиграв в рулетку чужие деньги. Её спасает и прячет у себя глухая танцовщица ночного клуба Яя, живущая единственной мечтой - накопить денег и уехать в некую сказочную \"страну глухих\", где живут только глухие люди, и поэтому царит добро и справедливость. Неожиданно девушки оказываются в центре жестокого столкновения двух кланов мафии, глухих и слышащих.

programme.title: Восьмёрка
programme.desc: Днём четыре друга служат в спецназе и безоговорочно выполняют приказы. Когда наступает вечер они гоняют по городу на белой "Восьмёрке" и устанавливают свои собственные бескомпромиссные правила. Ради любви эти современные мушкетёры готовы пожертвовать многим. Когда надо помочь другу, чтобы спасти любимую, четыре товарища вступают в схватку с главарем кровавой и безжалостной уличной банды, который контролирует весь город.

programme.title: Суходол
programme.desc: Это история Натальи, молодой и наивной девушки-крестьянки служащей в обедневшей дворянской семье в их деревенском поместье. Наталья не знает другой жизни, ее голова полна суеверий и страхов, но ее душа — душа героини. Через перипетии ее жизни: любовь, преданность хозяевам, мистический опыт, изгнание, предательство, веру, мы наблюдаем и то, как роковым образом складывается судьба семьи Хрущевых, в которой Наталья служит.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: One Strange Rock
programme.desc: Ever since life emerged, microbes, plants and animals have all sculpted the planets surface and atmosphere in the strangest of ways; fish poop creates islands; dead animals create mountains; plants help create continents. From rocks to rivers, life has crafted everything that makes our planet so special. But this power of change brings with it profound dangers. Life doesnt just create. It can also destroy.

programme.title: One Strange Rock
programme.desc: The freak accident behind complex life. All life on earth started as single cell bacteria and stayed like that for 2 billion years. Successfully spreading across the planet. So even if we do find alien life, what are the chances of that life being complex – like us? Vanishingly rare… on our strange rock, it's all down to a freak event, which accidentally happened when one cell ate another to create a kind of cellular power pack: mitochondria. This almost miraculous event transforms earth into a complex interconnected food web based on a competition for food. And at the top of the pyramid sits us humans.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Like all living beings, humans are survivors. The immutable evolutionary laws of Nature have winnowed out the weak over millions of years. In this episode we deconstruct the neuroscience behind human survival how we evolved to survive, and what role our ancient instincts still play today in keeping us alive. Get ready for some mind-boggling adventures of the human mind on this episode of Brain Games V.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Whether it's a blast from the past, recognizing a long lost pal, or remembering where you parked the car, your memory shapes the story of your life, and allows you to interact with the world around you without everything always seeming strange or unfamiliar. We show you what memory is, why you even have a memory – and why you keep forgetting where you put those darn keys! Play along and you'll also see why, sometimes, forgetting can actually be a good thing.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: What do you see when you look at the world? Does reality really exist the way you experience it? Your brain is constantly taking in different bits of information all at once to make meaningful patterns that eventually form a complete picture of the world around you. Whether it's light, shadow, distance, or sound, the way your brain perceives this information creates your unique perspective. But have you ever stopped to wonder if your brain is actually being fooled-or if your brain is fooling you? In this episode of Brain Games, you'll see how your brain gets tripped up by odd angles, how light and shadows play a crucial role in your perception of the world, how you can radically shift the way you see reality, and how your brain isn't always as honest with you as you think. Through a series of games and experiments, you'll discover why you shouldn't always believe what you see.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Brand new: Tim Shaw and Fuzz Townshend are off to Loughborough to take on a 1992 Saab 900 Turbo that's in desperate need of repair. The car belongs to Saab enthusiast and former electrical engineer Pravesh. Sadly, due to ill health, Pravesh has been left with little strength to work on the car, so it's been left to rot. His family believe getting his Saab back on the road would give him the boost he needs.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz head to Scotland to take on a 1993 Toyota Supra Mk.4 owned by former competitive motorcycle racer Lisa, who after a road accident is no longer able to ride her beloved bikes. Along came her Japanese supercar which helped fulfil her need for speed. Ongoing mobility problems have meant the car has ended in need of TLC. Lisa's friends and family hope a fully restored car will lift her spirits.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Master mechanics Fuzz Townshend and parts-blagging petrol head Tim Shaw are back for a brand new season of the fan favourite show Car S.O.S. The comedy duo have their work-cut out as they embark on more undercover missions rescuing classic cars and returning them in a surprise reveal to their much deserving owners. This season starts with a exhaust bang, as Tim and Fuzz are on a special mission to rescue a unique classic racing car and reunite it with a true racing legend...Sir Stirling Moss! But this 1962 Austin Healy Sebring Sprite, that once raced in a team that included Sir Stirling Moss, isn't in a fit state. But the guys have a plan to get this car back on the racetrack and Sir Stirling Moss back in the driving seat. Fuzz begins work in the garage whilst Tim goes in search of the original engine, and also finding time along the way to have a sit down with the racing legend himself. Will the Sprite be ready in time for Sir Stirling Moss to take it out for a spin? The guys also come across a supercar that's begging to be taken back to the swinging '60s, the Jaguar E-type. But the car's owner Mick is suffering from osteoporosis and has lost all hope that his beloved car will ever be back to its full glory. But Tim and Fuzz are working with Mick's family in secret to restore the car and give Mick a brilliant surprise. But when they discover it's a back to metal restoration this car looks like it's going to be more of a head-ache than a head-turner. Other cars festering away waiting for the guy's attention are Tim's all-time favourite: the Audi Quattro Turbo, the 3 wheeled 1934 Morgan F4, a retro 1982 Mk1 GTI and a 1995 Nissan Skyline GTR. So start up those engines, as Tim and Fuzz return this month for the ultimate car show with a heart.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: Amsterdam is celebrating its 750th anniversary, and Amsterdam Central Station stands at the heart of the festivities. Alongside the city's milestone, station manager René marks 25 years of service. Ticket & Service employees Gusta and Alexandra join the anniversary celebrations, while keeping a close eye on autumn showers drifting toward the station. With record crowds pouring in for the historic year, kiosk employee Rosa anxiously awaits a delivery as warehouse worker Ron struggles to stay on schedule. Safety & Service officers Menno and Baran are deployed for the high-risk Ajax-Inter Milan match, where managing supporters proves demanding. And as a fierce autumn storm sweeps through the capital during this landmark celebration, track workers race against time to replace worn rails and keep the anniversary city moving.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: The Christmas holidays begin under extreme conditions as the heaviest snowstorm in 5 years slams into the region, bringing transport to a near standstill. At Central Station, the Christmas spirit descends as thousands of additional holiday passengers are expected despite the weather, turning an already busy period into a logistical battle. Inside the control room, Code Orange is declared as delays cascade across the network. A stalled train compounds the disruption, while platforms grow crowded. Assistant station manager Michel coordinates Christmas decorations while Ticket & Service staff Alexandra and Gusta help create a festive atmosphere. Meanwhile, Safety & Service officers Menno and Baran respond to one incident after another. With snow piling up and pressure mounting, everybody must work together to prevent total gridlock.

programme.title: Expedition Everest
programme.desc: Just inside Everestâs notorious âdeath zoneâ, a team of climate scientists who specialize in extreme weather weigh their next move. Theyâre part of a groundbreaking expedition set out to investigate what the worldâs highest peak has to tell us. Days on end of bad weather has made this yearâs season more dangerous than ever, but this unpredictable pattern is precisely why they are here: to install the highest weather station in the world and learn more about what conditions in the Himalayas mean for our enti

programme.title: Wolves Up Close with Bertie Gregory
programme.desc: National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory returns to Hudson Bay in Arctic Canada to check in on some old friends: a pack of wolves led by their fearless leader, Kona. Winter is their most punishing season. Food is scarce, forcing the pack to take on their biggest and most dangerous prey, the moose. Facing an animal 10 times their size, one wrong move could be fatal. It's this battle of size versus strategy that Bertie has come to film. What he witnesses and captures is a rarely seen event — and an unforgettable moment for a member of his favorite pack.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Contraband Capture
programme.desc: A CBP intelligence effort in Mississippi triggers the interception and search of several trucks suspected of carrying illicit cargo. Off the Florida coast, AMO agents board a yacht arriving from Jamaica and are forced to draw their weapons when the crew fails to comply. At San Juan airport, a couple returning from Colombia is diverted to secondary after officers uncover mysterious medications in their bags, prompting further investigation.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Korean Air Cargo Flight #8509 Boeing 747-Freighter Scheduled to return to Seoul via Milan, Italy, Korean Air Cargo Flight #8509 idles on the tarmac at England's Stansted Airport. With a new crew on board and nearly an hour behind schedule, the aircraft finally takes off and climbs to 2,500 feet. But just a few seconds later, the plane banks sharply to the left and slams into a field northeast of London. All four crewmembers die instantly in the huge explosion and a massive crater 30 feet deep marks the point of impact. It is Korean Airlines' fifth major accident in two-and-a-half years and as investigators unravel the case, their search for answers leads them to back Korea.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Pacific Southwest Airlines Flight #182 Boeing 727 On its early morning run down the California coast, PSA Flight #182 is arriving at San Diego's Lindbergh Airport. Warned that a Cessna is flying immediately ahead of them, the pilots of the 727 confirm they see the plane and are instructed to maintain visual separation. But just minutes later, Flight #182 collides with the Cessna and both planes crash into a quiet residential neighborhood below. With 144 people dead including 7 victims on the ground, it is the biggest airline disaster in American history and investigators must determine what happened and who is is at fault.

programme.title: Plane Crash Recreated
programme.desc: On the final leg of its around-the-world route in 1956, Pan Am 6 sets off from Honolulu bound for San Francisco. Carrying only 24 passengers, the Boeing Stratocruiser is the epitome of luxury in this golden age of flight. However, midway over the Pacific, Pan Am 6 encounters engine trouble. Now unable to reach California or return to Hawaii, the crew must ditch in the open ocean. A nearby U.S. Coast Guard vessel picks up the distress call and races to intercept. After circling until dawn, Pan Am 6 attempts the landing on water. The aircraft breaks apart, but amazingly none of the 31 people onboard are killed. Survivor accounts retell the extraordinary landing and daring rescue operation. Discover the precariousness of early engines and the evolution of safety standards taken for granted today.

programme.title: Plane Crash Recreated
programme.desc: Pakistan International Airlines Flight 8303 was near the end of its 90-minute journey from Lahore to Karachi when it dramatically crashed on 22 May 2020. While attempting a second approach after a failed landing, the Airbus A320 tragically collided with a densely populated residential area of Karachi only a few kilometres from the runway. In this episode, we hear from one of only two survivors of the horrific crash..

programme.title: Is It Real?
programme.desc: Is It Real? sorts the facts from fiction in modern-day myths about supernatural phenomena. The show explores some of the more common myths such as crop circles and ghosts, as well as some of the far out myths like spontaneous human combustion. The series looked at these topics from a skeptical point of view, going at them with the attitude of, "Oh yeah? Then prove it." Frequently, the people making the more outrageous claims could not.

programme.title: The Truth Behind
programme.desc: Atlantis, the legendary island believed to have sunk beneath the waves thousands of years ago, has puzzled the academic community for generations. Though many sites have been put forward, the Atlantis described by the philosopher Plato remains a mystery. The Truth Behind Atlantis aims to dive into the murky depths of the controversies that surround the island, sifting through historical accounts, scientific experiments and academic opinion. It's a journey that takes us to the tropical Bahamas, Miami, Santorini and to an archaeological site on Crete, as we untangle the past to discover the real story of Atlantis.

programme.title: Monsters: The Truth Behind the Myths
programme.desc: Inspired by a dare from a literary giant - and inspired by unchecked scientific progress - Mary Shelley transforms a nightmare into one of the most enduring horror stories of all time. Centuries later, Frankenstein's monster maintains its grip on our collective psyche, alongside film adaptations and new scientific advancements that blur the line between progress and ethics.

programme.title: Monsters: The Truth Behind the Myths
programme.desc: Discover how a bloodsucking legend crept into our nightmares. Mysterious deaths fuel a vampire panic in 18th century Serbia. The fear spreads when a government inquiry legitimizes vampires. An enlightened empress outlaws vampire hunting. Then—just as science strips fiction from fact—literature and mass media give vampires a makeover that means they remain culturally relevant.

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: In 1898, a stunning object shows up at the British Museum. Carved and polished from a single piece of quartz, it is shaped like an immaculate human skull. Is this a creation of Mesoamericans, as originally claimed? Why is it rumoured to possess supernatural power? A gruesome-looking chair from ancient China, housed at the Wellcome Collection in London, is covered in sword blades, spikes and ornate decorations. Clearly, this is no love seat. Is it some kind of torture device, or more than meets the eye? From a long-buried library in the lost Assyrian city of Nineveh comes a peculiar round tablet scribbled with cuneiform writing. Is it the work of astronomers, proof of an ancient apocalypse, or a 3,000-year-old instruction manual?

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: In 1995, a bone of an extinct bear is found in a Slovenian cave that could rewrite our place in the story of evolution. The bone appears to be carved with intention by someone at least 10,000 years before humans arrived in that part of the world. Who made it and why? A simple black dress shoe sits in a glass case in the Heinz Nixdorf Museums Forum in Germany. The reason? More than just a shoe, this is a high-tech machine for its time, designed to do the impossible: beat the casino. And an intricate purple gemstone adorned with silver snakes, quartz scarabs and cryptic words, has a long history intertwined with illness, ruin, tragedy and death. Where did it originate, and could it really be cursed?

programme.desc: In Odda, an epic landslide closes the main road, leaving a pick-up and a van crushed. With over one thousand truck loads of rock to be removed, it takes nine days before Thord's even allowed on site to recover the vehicles. But when he arrives, fresh rain de-stabilises the ground and the mountain begins to rumble - making Thord fearful of another rockfall. In Eidfjord, Bjoern turns teacher when 18 year old Ida joins him to rescue a nine-ton drill rig that slid off a trailer. But with only one tow truck he's come undergunned - and risks being taught a hard lesson himself.

programme.title: Ice Rroad Rescue 10
programme.desc: When a landslip takes out an excavator on a remote forest track, Thord and Bjoern join forces. But when the unstable ground threatens the rescue, the mission turns into a twelve-day challenge. In Odda, after another landslide, Domenic fears falling into the water trying to rescue a car that's been swept into the fjord. One thousand kilometres north, in Overhalla, Torstein's in double trouble when a truck and a car crash at the same spot. Final

programme.title: Yukon Rescue
programme.desc: An ice jam has severed the remote community of West Dawson from emergency services, leaving residents trapped. A 911 call comes in from across the river, and Chief Mike and his team of volunteers face a nightmare scenario. With no safe routes in or out, volunteer firefighter Chris must brave the treacherous makeshift trails across unstable ice. A terrifying accident on the way home forces an unconventional team of volunteer first responders to come to the rescue. Meanwhile, in Whitehorse, a fierce blizzard batters the highways, burying vehicles and leaving travellers stranded. As conditions spiral into chaos, Ray makes an urgent call for reinforcements, knowing that time is running out for those caught in the storm's icy grip.

programme.title: Yukon Rescue
programme.desc: Avalanche technicians race to repair a remote weather station before an incoming storm. The escalating risks force them to carry out a bombing mission to flush out a dangerous buildup of snow above the Klondike Highway. Meanwhile, Dawson City is left reeling from the loss of the person they rely on the most to keep them safe. In Whitehorse, Ray embarks on a remote, high-stakes rescue mission along a snow-covered back road, only to get stuck himself as daylight dwindles and temperatures plummet.

Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: CBP Nogales stops a pedestrian carrying fentanyl internally and seizes a vehicle with a mixed load of heroin and fentanyl with a combined street value of over $760,000. Spring breakers return to Atlanta's airport with varying contraband, including $38,000 of undeclared cash inside a bag of dirty laundry.

programme.title: Wolves Up Close with Bertie Gregory
programme.desc: National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory returns to Hudson Bay in Arctic Canada to check in on some old friends: a pack of wolves led by their fearless leader, Kona. Winter is their most punishing season. Food is scarce, forcing the pack to take on their biggest and most dangerous prey, the moose. Facing an animal 10 times their size, one wrong move could be fatal. It's this battle of size versus strategy that Bertie has come to film. What he witnesses and captures is a rarely seen event — and an unforgettable moment for a member of his favorite pack.

programme.title: Science of Stupid

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: This is a show about your brain and stress. Youll see how your brain manages stress and how stress also manages you. From traffic jams to screaming babies, angry bosses to bill payments, youre surrounded by stress everyday. But stress has a purpose, and youll discover why its a good thing in many situations, even though it can overwhelm you. But dont let that stress you outthere are ways to manage it! Through a series of interactive games and experiments,youll discover how stress works and how to handle it better. So sit back, relax and dont stress out…on Brain Games.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: In this episode we're busting some widely held myths and figuring out why the brain believes them. Everyone knows that alcohol kills brain cells, your IQ is a fixed number you're born with, and we use only 10 percent of our brains...Right? Well, not quite. These beliefs are misconceptions perpetuated by popular opinion. This raises some questions: How much of what we think we know is actually true?

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Humans are the most dominant species on the planet … but why? We're not the strongest, fastest, or largest. We don't have the best sight, smell, or hearing. So how come we're the ones in charge? It's because of our brains. No other species can produce literature, solve complex math or science problems, or build machines like cars, computers, and space stations. How do our brains stack up against the brains of other species? We'll try to find out when we pit animals against humans in a series of unique competitions.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz head to Kent to rescue a much-loved 1973 Dennis Fire Engine. Previously belonging to New Romney station, firefighter Tony cherished it as his own and years later purchased it to restore and use to raise money for charity. Sadly, Tony passed away from cancer and never completed the restoration. Colleagues have nominated his son James for the Car SOS treatment to see his dad's wishes come true.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz head to Manchester to rescue a rusting Citroen HY van that was originally purchased so 19 year-old Darcie and her mum Alison could start up their own mobile catering business. Sadly, the dream was shattered when Alison was killed in the Manchester Arena suicide bombing in 2017. Will the boys be able to work their magic and get the Citroen back on the road? Former England footballers Bryan Robson and Wes Brown join in to help restore the fortunes of a family torn apart by tragic events.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz have taken on one of the great unsung heroes of World War 2 : a 1941 Austin 10 Utility truck , the workhorse of the British army. It belongs to 89 year old, former soldier Ted who has used the truck on his farm for over 60 years. Remarkably, for a farm vehicle, the truck has remained in an extraordinary state of preservation and Fuzz wants to keep it that way: it's a case of conservation over restoration, but will Tim agree?

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Making motoring dreams come true for a fifth season Car SOS is back, and this time it's bigger and better than ever. Everyone's favourite petrol heads Fuzz Townshend and Tim Shaw continue their mission to seek out classic cars with deserving owners. Using all their guile and restoration knowledge their aim is to sneak away clapped out classics without their owners knowing then in a blizzard of grease and grime and hard graft get the much loved motors back where they deserve to be, on the road. In this series the boys take on their biggest challenges ever. Chronic rust, hard to find parts and broken engines test the boys to their limits. British classics, Italian roadsters, German grand tourers and French hot hatches from across seven decades of motoring history make the most astonishing line-up Car SOS has ever had, and, for their lucky owners the surprise they will never forget.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: Oklahoma City Bombing: One Day in America
programme.desc: President Clinton arrives in Oklahoma as grieving families come together to remember those they have lost. The nation grapples with the reality that the bomber is an American veteran who shows no remorse. As the trial begins, the government seeks the death penalty for the worst domestic terrorist attack in U.S. history.

programme.title: The Stanford Prison Experiment: Unlocking the Truth
programme.desc: A groundbreaking look at the infamous Stanford Prison Experiment, through the first-hand accounts of the original prisoners and guards. Their stories unravel a new narrative that interrogates the motives of the man pulling the strings, Dr. Philip Zimbardo, while exploring larger questions of human nature and the power of perspective. Utilizing Rashomon-style reenactments and an Act of Killing-inspired reunion component, the project brings the layers of storytelling to unexpected levels.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur.

programme.title: X-Ray Earth
programme.desc: Beneath our feet, under trillions of tons of rock, lurk astonishing and deadly secrets. Earthquakes, tsunamis, volcanic eruptions are all driven by hidden forces deep inside our planet. Now, using the latest scientific data from sensors and surface scans, we can x-ray the earth to reveal the dangers locked inside our planet.Using thousands of sensors and state of the art surface scan information, for the first time, we can create x-rays of the deep interior of our planet.

programme.title: A Gathering Storm
programme.desc: A super typhoon in the Pacific creates havoc in the rough seas of the deadliest fishing ground in the world - the Bering Sea. Typhoon Hagibis intensifies with incredibly speed as it heads for Japan. While the nation braces for a devastating impact, seafarers are on alert in the deadly waters of the North Pacific. Cameras on board cargo ships, fishing boats, and military vessels capture the action as they face the monster storm.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Air traffic controllers hear an explosion when Air Algérie Flight 6289 lifts off from a remote desert airport. And moments later, the Boeing 737-200 crashes in the Sahara. An intense fire ravages the fuselage, instantly killing all but one of the 103 people on board. For an international team of investigators, it's clear the left engine exploded after liftoff—and that a fatigue crack eventually explains why. What's less obvious is why the highly-experienced crew of the state-owned national carrier was unable to keep their aircraft in the sky. Single-engine failures are infinitely survivable, and the pilots should have been able to recover by working together. Investigators ultimately find their answer in the CVR and in a toxic tug-of-war between a belligerent captain working at cross purposes with Algeria's first-ever female airline pilot.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: During a regional commuter hop in New Zealand, the pilots of Eagle Airways Flight 2300 struggle to lower their landing gear. They circle the airport to troubleshoot the issue. Low on fuel, they have no choice but to eventually attempt a wheels-up landing. With emergency crews standing by, their twin-engine turboprop gently touches down, slides along the centre of the runway, and comes to a stop—remarkably with no injuries and minimal damage to the aircraft. With a potential disaster narrowly averted, investigators look into what could have caused the landing gear to fail. They soon track a hydraulic leak to a minor part with a major flaw. When they later test the entire fleet of Beechcraft turboprops, they uncover a systemic issue that's endangering passengers worldwide.

programme.title: Is It Real?
programme.desc: Everyone knows Count Dracula is the product of Bram Stokers imagination, but is this enduring pop-culture icon based in reality? With the help of historians, folklorists, forensic science and modern medicine we investigate the enduring vampire myth. We travel to the Carpathian Mountains in Romania to find out whether the fictional count was based on a real-life historical figure. We meet a modern-day vampire who drinks human blood to replenish his energy. And a forensic scientist explains why a family might be convinced that a recently deceased relative has turned into vampire and is feasting on the blood of the living.

programme.title: History's Secrets

Discover new clues about the reclusive billionaire Howard Hughes; the CIA's top-secret experiments; the Unabomber and; little known stories from NASA's Apollo missions.

programme.title: Ultimate Airport Dubai
programme.desc: Dubai International is in the global race to be the world's biggest airport. A massive new concourse for the world's largest fleet of A380's uses over a 150 million man-hours and 930 thousand cubic meters of concrete. Unafraid of new challenges, the airport was the first ever to close two runways back to back for construction. In the words of its Engineering CEO, "the bar is getting higher and higher." There is no room for failure in Dubai.

programme.title: Ultimate Airport Dubai
programme.desc: To maintain its place as one of the busiest airports in the world, Dubai International needs to run like clockwork. Failure in any single department can have major consequences across the whole airport. This episode follows an emergency in air traffic control that leads to a runway closure, a huge task to re-number every departure gate in the airport while it is operational, and the mounting tension on the building site of a new $3.2 billion terminal extension - built specifically to accommodate the A380, the world's biggest passenger airliner.

programme.desc: If you think you have full control of your thoughts and actions — think again. The clothes you wear, the food you eat and even the way you walk has less to do with you and more to do with everyone else. In this episode, we'll explore whether your brain is hardwired to want to fit in. Through a series of games and experiments, we'll prove that the decisions that you think make you unique also make you a part of the crowd. Some of what we're about to point out might make you look like a fool, but your brain's tendency to conform evolved to protect you and might even help you succeed.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: This is a show about your brain and its imagination. We often associate imagination with creativity and the arts, but we don't always think about how important it is to our daily lives. If you play along you'll see how you can use your imagination to solve daily problems, you'll learn how to tap into the imaginative process, and that, with a little help, you can keep the good ideas flowing. Get ready to unleash your imagination…on Brain Games.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: Port Protection is home to the few who have left behind normal society and chosen a different life in a remote Alaskan community, where survival of the individuals and community cannot sustain without the other. The stakes are high. The land is rugged and unforgiving and the seas which surround Port Protection are cold and merciless. With risk comes a reward more profound than mere survival: a world of beauty and freedom with the security of community and without the constraints of bureaucracy. In Port Protection there are no clear roads to survival, inhabitants must carve one themselves.

programme.desc: It's a foggy day at Ireland's Cork Airport and the pilots of Manx2 Flight 7100 are circling the airport waiting for the weather to clear. After controllers clear the turboprop commuter plane for landing, the pilots reduce their speed and descend, but the aircraft suddenly goes into a severe roll and crashes into the runway. It's the deadliest crash in Ireland in decades, and it's up to the Irish Air Accident Investigation Unit to figure out what went wrong. They soon discover the fog is only part of the story, and the investigation reveals a startling gap in aviation safety that has put passengers' lives at risk.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Toronto Airport Uncovered

programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur.

programme.title: Paranatural
programme.desc: Different cultures call it different things: Bigfoot, Sasquatch, Abominable Snowman and Yeti, but theyre all talking about the same phenomenon and the descriptions are similar: large, hair-covered creatures that walk upright like humans; creatures that live out of sight across the world. Eyewitness accounts stretch back in time, but for many, the Sasquatch is the poster child of the Paranatural, a figment of fevered imaginations, a mere shadow in the woods. But those who say theyve come face to face with this elusive being have no doubt about its existence.

programme.title: Monsters: The Truth Behind the Myths
programme.desc: Discover how a bloodsucking legend crept into our nightmares. Mysterious deaths fuel a vampire panic in 18th century Serbia. The fear spreads when a government inquiry legitimizes vampires. An enlightened empress outlaws vampire hunting. Then—just as science strips fiction from fact—literature and mass media give vampires a makeover that means they remain culturally relevant.

programme.title: Monsters: The Truth Behind the Myths
programme.desc: The history of werewolves takes us back to ancient beliefs regardin man and wolf but it's in the 16th century that a killing spree sees werewolves enter the courtoom. At the French court, the werewolf is reborn as a cautionary fary tale. The longstanding vilification of wolves and animal behaviour shapes the legend and mass media sends the myth into overdrive.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Santa Barbara Airlines Flight 518, an ATR 42-300 twin-turboprop, is about to embark on a difficult, but common, trip from Merida, Venezuela to Caracas. Minutes after leaving the ground, all aboard are killed when the aircraft crashes into a mountaintop, miles off course. What happened? Relive this devastating 2008 air disaster and witness the demanding recovery mission at an altitude of 14,000 feet. Then join the investigation as experts comb through evidence and discover a lethal combination of bad equipment and bad decisions.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Martinair Flight 495 is seconds from landing at Portugal's Faro Airport when the storm it's flying through takes a sudden turn for the worse. On touchdown, the DC-10 erupts in flames and tears apart as it slides more than 350 feet off the runway. Miraculously, most of the 340 passengers and crew survive the crash, but 56 people are killed, and investigators need to determine the cause of the accident. Bad weather appears to be the main culprit, but the discovery of a two-inch deep cut down the runway raises troubling new questions.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Harrowing stories of tragedy and triumph are brought to life through official reports, transcripts and interviews with the pilots, air traffic controllers and lucky survivors of history's most terrifying crashes. Widely considered to be the safest form of travel, air transportation is still in its infancy and when midair calamity strikes, the results are often catastrophic. From the cockpit to the cabin, from the control room to the crash scene, we uncover just what went wrong.

programme.title: Guerilla Gold Rush: Deadly Endeavor
programme.desc: Investigative reporter Mariana Van Zeller uncovers the dark side of gold mining. Gold has fueled dreams and vast wealth in Colombian life for centuries. And everyone is chasing after it—corporate mining companies, artisanal miners, and armed groups. Van Zeller meets face-to-face with illegal river miners, a former intelligence officer, and a masked guerilla commander to get the inside story.

programme.title: The Fall Of Osama Bin Laden
programme.desc: Journalist Peter Bergen returns to investigate the United States intelligence operation to hunt down and kill the world's most wanted terrorist. Take a deep dive into critical intel gathered by Navy SEALs on hard drives and in a collection of letters and journals confiscated from bin Laden's Abbottabad compound.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: Shrouded by mystery, the Lost Treasures of Egypt clears the sand away from your eyes in revealing the secrets of this Ancient Civilisation. From the Valley of Kings to the Pyramids of Giza, we uncover hidden tombs and foretell the stories of ruling pharaohs through the artefacts, that we find along the way. Following the excavations of international experts, we unearth historical context at various archaeological sites. At the end of this series, you should be enlightened with numerous Egyptian theories such as "mummification" and the 'Curse of the Afterlife'. With royalty as Tutankhamun and Cleopatra, we explore the impacts these figures had at the time and the lasting dynasty they have since left behind, for modern Egypt.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt Compilations
programme.desc: Meet the bada#$ queens of ancient Egypt as archeologists read between the hieroglyphs to find the true stories of Cleopatra and Hatshepsut. Of all the hidden mysteries of Egypt, the lives of these queens who would be king are among the most compelling. Immensely powerful, they created larger-than-life legends that have withstood the test of time. Now, archeologists seek to uncover their secrets ?such as where Cleopatra is buried. Even after two millennia, a sandstorm of mystery will swirls around her life? and her story lives on.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: As gateways to eternal life, Egypt's tombs were built to last forever. But thousands of years later, time is winning. In a race to save hidden treasures, archaeological teams excavate the pyramids and burial sites on the verge of collapse. In Abusir, Dr. Mohamed Ishmail Khaled hunts for a long-lost royal chamber, before shifting stones seal it forever. In Philadelphia, Dr. Basem Gehad descends a shaft held up by crumbling sand walls in search of an unexplored tomb. Near Luxor, crews haul debris from a steep, unstable corridor leading to a newly discovered chamber. Every move is a risk to both the archaeologists and the fragile relics they're racing to protect.

programme.title: Pompeii: Out of Time with Tom Hiddleston
programme.desc: As the final, lethal surges strike, Tom Hiddleston confronts the final question: What does it mean to survive? Investigating Julia Felix's final decision, the Praetorian's sacrifice and the fate of Avianius, Tom uncovers new evidence that challenges everything we think we know about Pompeii. In the face of total destruction, he reveals not just who lived but what survival really meant.

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: Edgar Cayce, known as the "sleeping prophet," claims to use hypnotic states to heal the sick and see the future. Cayce is alleged to have predicted the Wall Street Crash of 1929, the Second World War, and the assassination of JFK. His aura stokes fear around his most frightening prediction of all — the end of the world. In Ancient Greece, the Oracle of Delphi is the premier prophesier of the ancient world. The words of this Pythia, channeled down from Apollo, go on to shape human history, foretelling the rise and fall of empires. And in 19th-century France, radical occult thinker Eliphas Lévi draws upon early mysticism to develop a spiritual doctrine. Branded as a devil worshiper by the public, the truth of his life's work is even stranger.

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: When cases run cold, police in 1970s U.S. call upon the services of Dorothy Allison — the most celebrated "psychic detective" of her time. From the kidnapping of Patty Hearst to the crimes of Son of Sam, Allison sometimes provides incredible insights. In the 2010s, John of God is a leading light of the New Age movement with celebrity followers. He calls himself a psychic healer, but those closest to the man know that the truth is darker than anyone can imagine. In the first century C.E., Jewish commander Josephus is captured by the Romans. Apparently using ancient prophecy for political ends, he tells his captor, Roman General Vespasian, that he is prophesied to rule the world. The consequences have far-reaching effects on human history.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: It is one of Earths few landforms visible from space, a World Heritage site, and one of Americas most popular National Park with over nearly five million visitors a year. But at the edge of a chasm, visitors see only a tiny fraction of the Grand Canyons true beauty hidden amidst its stone, its water and its wildlife. Even for scientists it is a place of baffling mysteries. How and when was it actually formed? Why does one of the planets deadliest diseases still endure in the Canyons premier carnivore the majestic mountain lion? What drove one of the largest birds on earth, the California Condor, to the brink of extinction? Why do microscopic colonies of vegetation that bind the desert sand where no other plant can survive take years to regenerate from the pressure of a single human footfall. And finally what of the Canyons earliest human inhabitants? Where did they live? How did they survive? National Geographic Television joins a rare scientific odyssey down the Grand Canyons entire 277-mile length through some of the most treacherous rapids on the planet to try to unlock the mysteries of this great unknown. A select group of scientists and experts will show us a Grand Canyon few outsiders ever see. From the river still cutting through two-billion-year-old stone to the creatures roaming its incomparable back-country, the Grand Canyon still has secrets to tell.

programme.title: Hr Krokodill
programme.desc: Martin ehitas uue boccia palli väljaku ja korraldab turniiri. Daisy ja ema loovad tiimi ning hr Krokodill on treener. See on nende viis veeta ema-tütre-krokodilli aega. Aga võistluse edenedes hakkab Daisy muretsema, et kui nad ei võida, siis ta valmistab emas pettumust. Ta peab leidma viisi, kuidas mitte ema alt vedada aga samas öelda, mida ta tunneb. // Gigi läheb linnuspaasse ja hr Krokodill ning Daisy valvavad ta pesa. Kui ta on läinud, otsustavad nad Gigile üllatuse teha, remontides ta pesa, et see oleks luksuslik nagu linnuspaa. Kui ta naaseb, siis ta ei tunne oma pesa ära. Ta on neile tänulik, aga ta igatseb oma vana pesa ja ei tunne uues end üldse kodus. programme.title: Rubble ja meeskond

programme.title: Käpapatrull

programme.title: Käpapatrull

programme.desc: Käpa-Patrull on eelkooliealiste sari, peaosas grupp kangelaslikke kutsikaid: Chase, Marshall, Rocky, Zuma, Rubble ja Skye, keda juhib 10-aastane tehnikataibuga poiss Ryder. programme.title: Hr Krokodill
programme.desc: Roland teeb jalale haiget ja peab ülejäänud päeva puhkama, mitte töötama. Rolandi jaoks on see raske. Talle meeldib olla aktiivne ja asju teha. Daisy ja hr Krokodill koos Gigi, Kiara ja Amiriga aitavad Rolandil oma tööde nimekirja lõpetada, et ta saaks puhata. Aga Rolandi nimekiri on väga pikk, talle on raske meele järele olla ja talle ei meeldi niisama istuda. Daisy ja hr Krokodill õpivad, et kõik ei lõõgastu samamoodi. // Sellest hetkest kui hr Krokodill ärkab, läheb kõik nässu. Ta kukub voodist välja, peab sulgpallireketit hambaharjaks ja jääb Daisyga kohtumisele hiljaks. Gigi saab aru: hr Krokodillil on halb päev. Daisy, Gigi ja hr Krokodill kardavad, et terve päev läheb kõik valesti, seega nad uurivad viise, kuidas ta halb päev tagasi pöörata ja ülejäänud päev heaks teha.

programme.title: Käpapatrull
programme.desc: Kui Raimundo uusim tsirkuseetendus - jõehobu Daisy ja tema tantsivad jõehobubeebid - trapetsi maha tõmbavad, peavad Ryder ja Käpa-Patrull selle enne suure etenduse algust uuesti püsti panema. Olles unikaalne segu probleemide lahendamise oskustest, ägedatest sõidukitest ja armsast rohkest kutsahuumorist, teeb Käpa-Patrull koostööd ülitähtsatel päästeoperatsioonidel, et kaitsta Seiklustelahe kogukonda. Tuletõrjekoer Marshallist politseikoer Chase'ini, ja Skye'ni, kes lendab kõrgelt oma helikopteriga, näitavad nad tiimitöö ja hea kodakondsuse tähtsust. Neil kõigil on seljas omaenda eriline Kutsakott, mis aitab neil kõigega toime tulla - kassipoegade aitamisest rongi päästmiseni kalju äärelt! Ja pole vahet kui suur on seiklus, Käpa-Patrullil on alati aega mänguks, naeruks ja üheks kõrvasügamiseks Ryderilt. Lõbus Käpa-Patrulli fakt: Ryder päästis kõik need kutsad ja õpetas neile nende Käpa-Patrulli oskused.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis
programme.desc: Nine-year-old twins, Jade and Mica know Marsupilimis are real, as their explorer parents entrusted them with three precious eggs that hatched into Marsups named Hope, Twister, and Punch. They now live happily with the twins and their Gran Gran Suzanne above the family restaurant The Chahuta in Palombia, whilst the Twins parents search for the Marsups family. Living with three young Marsupilamis is an endless source of adventures. Jade and Mica love having having fun with them, but know, it's essential to keep their existence hidden from the outside world to keep them safe. Every day brings new challenges - taking the Marsupilamis to the park can quickly turn into a frantic race through the sewers and a confrontation with a wild jaguar, or a game of golf can result in capture by Stan the zoologist! Jade and Mica learn just as much from these fun furry creatures as the Marsupilamis learn from them - they make a great team and family!

Mr. Krabs and SpongeBob agree to cafeteria duty, however, they're closely supervised by Lenore and she forbids outside food! SpongeBob and Mr. Krabs try to sneakily cook Krabby Patties but Lenore catches them, sparking a food fight! As the food flies, Lenore tastes a Krabby Patty...and loves it! They move the food fight to the Krusty Krab. Mr. Krabs is thrilled - the more patties they throw, the more he sells!

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover
programme.desc: Chloe has been absent from school while on missions with her siblings, and is assigned summer school to make up her missing work. Max thinks it's hilarious that she will have to spend the summer in school, until he is also informed that he will be the teacher. While they both pout about having to be in class all summer, Phoebe goes solo on some superhero mission. When a couple villains get the upper hand, a mysterious new superhero names Captain Perfect arrives to rescue her. Phoebe discovers that she and Captain Perfect have many of the same interests, and make a good crime-fighting team. As Phoebe wonders if she might have a new partner, Captain Perfect privately lets a contact know that he has earned Phoebe's trust and is ready for the next phase of his assignment.

programme.title: Danger Force
programme.desc: This fun spin-off of Henry Danger is set in the Swellview Academy for the Gifted and follows the adventures of four young friends. Chapa, Miles, Bose and Mika were ordinary kids, until they discovered they have superpowers. They are recruited by Captain Man to become his new crime-fighting crew, and protect the city of Swellview from various villains. But before that Captain Man must teach them how to control their superpowers, as well as to how to work as a team, using Schwoz as his helper.

programme.title: Henry Danger
programme.desc: Henry Danger is a story about adventures of a 13-year-old Henry Hart who is lucky to become a helpmate of a super hero Captain Man. This is a real dream job of every teen. The newbie is getting paid for fighting against crime and helping to save the world. Brave Henry must hide his job from his family and friends and it is not that simple, but nothing can stop him from being a true crime-fighter. Henry himself wants to become a super hero one day, that is why he is constantly learning from Captain Man and is not scared of any hardships on the way to his dream.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

But during the ceremony, when Mrs. Wong and Dr. Colosso both discover that the other is broke, they call off the wedding themselves. Dr. Colosso uses the dirt he gathered on Mrs. Wong to ensure that she keeps Max and Phoebe's superhero identities a secret. Chloe tries to dissuade them, but when they discover a mask and cape in Principal Ferguson's bag, Booch and Jinx are convinced they've found a real superhero.

programme.desc: After Mrs. Benson pushes Freddie too far by making Freddie eat asparagus while doing iCarly, showing people at school his baby pictures, and vacuuming his ear while he was sleeping, Freddie gets upset, moves out and gets his own apartment on the top floor of Bushwell Plaza. In the meanwhile, Carly, Sam, and Freddie start a pet photography business, only to see their studio destroyed by a snooty competing pet photography business owners Stewart Butler and Ollie Paisley. In the end, Marissa realizes she needs Freddie, begging him to return; Freddie makes her promise not to embarrass him in public ever again.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: iCarly is about teenager Carly who produces her own web show named iCarly along with her three friends Freddie, Sam and Gibby. The show is broadcasted from a studio Carly constructed in the flat where she lives with her 29 years old brother and guardian Spencer. While producing a webshow Carly is not looking for fame or fortune. Ideally she wants to be a role model for children and teenagers. iCarly ultimately features everything from comedy sketches and talent contests to interviews, recipes, and problem-solving.

programme.title: Victorious
programme.desc: Chaos is coming to Tori Vega's life. The 16 year old is starting at a new high school; but not just any school. This is Hollywood Arts, a performing arts school where crazy talented students learn how to become real artists.. Until now, Tori didn't think she had much talent of her own, and was content to live in the shadow of her older sister, Trina. Now, that's all about to change... if Tori can see herself in a new light, even a spotlight! But Hollywood Arts is still a high school, and Tori is still the new kid. She'll have to find new friends, do homework, and just try to fit in. Will Tori grab a starring role in her new life?

programme.title: Sam & Cat
programme.desc: Prepare to meet the strangest match made in bestie heaven -- Sam & Cat! Sam's loud, independent, and tough as nails, while Cat is sweet as pie and super flighty. But that doesn't stop this unlikely pair from becoming best buds and roomies! Together, they're a power duo with a love for fun and adventure -- it's just too bad that it doesn't come cheap. A booming out-of-home babysitting business quickly becomes the answer to their empty-pocket problems, but also an extra reason for countless wacky adventures to come!

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

When trouble oozes into the streets of New York City, the team finds themselves up against Mechazoids, street gangs, and even the storm of the century! No matter the obstacle, these heroes in a half shell are ready for action with heart and a whole lot of humor.

programme.desc: Chaos is coming to Tori Vega's life. The 16 year old is starting at a new high school; but not just any school. Until now, Tori didn't think she had much talent of her own, and was content to live in the shadow of her older sister, Trina. Now, that's all about to change... if Tori can see herself in a new light, even a spotlight! But Hollywood Arts is still a high school, and Tori is still the new kid. She'll have to find new friends, do homework, and just try to fit in. Will Tori grab a starring role in her new life?

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Raphael's brothers just don't understand him. Not only does he NEED to fight, he's really good at it, or at least that's what his new boxing trainer named Spuds told him. Spuds even ENCOURAGES Raph to work out his anger and negativity through fighting, even if his family and the annoying Pigeon Pete don't get it. But although the Turtles don't see eye to eye, they must work together to stop a rampaging Rocksteady and Bebop from wrecking the city! He stumbles onto a jackpot oak tree which is loaded with acorns (that's tons of money to animal folk). He's going to need financial advice, and who better to offer sound advice than King Julien? The two enter a partnership looking for ways to spend on the good life. The Red Squirrel has designs on the loot, though, and captures the hapless twosome in order to squeeze the acorns out of them. Will the evil squirrel's precisely planned plot pay or get him played? The Terror of Madagascar: A special delivery has come from Madagascar. What is it? A baby Fossa! Everyone is enchanted by the little tyke except King Julien, who sees him as a lemur-devouring predator, and he has the toothmarks on his butt to prove it! Julien formulates a plan to get rid of the adorable little carnivore, but his slithery solution becomes much worse than the problem!

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Best Laid Plaintains: It's a special day when Bada and Bing get a shipment of delicious plantains to eat. Although they jealously guard the African bananas, King Julien's determined to taste them too. He sneaks into the gorilla habitat while they sleep, and he and Marlene end up eating a few too many for the gorillas not to notice. Like all of them. When they realize what they've done they head for the hills as fast as their stolen car can take them. Can the penguins calm the savage beasts before they bash the banana bandits? P.E.L.T.: Skipper's losing it. His performance on the obstacle course is actually slowing down, so he has to trigger a special fitness test to prove he can still lead the squad. Kowalski takes over as Skipper excuses himself to go on his fitness quest. The brainy bird appears to do a bang-up job in the leadership role - are Skipper's days at the helm over but he's too chicken to admit it?

programme.title: Sonic Prime
programme.desc: Dread's obsession with recapturing his shard overrules all reason. Rusty Rose agrees the shard is too powerful for any one person, including Sonic. Caught between captain and crew, Sonic fights for his life.

programme.title: Sonic Prime
programme.desc: Rebel Rouge and Renegade Knuckles walk the newly liberated streets of New Yoke City unsure what's next, but at least they're free. Until... the Mothership redocks atop the YOKE, Sonic and Dread - stowaways - fall to the streets below, fates uncertain.

programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

After being swallowed whole multiple times, Lily and Jack realize they must take a different approach, but then they hear horror stories from other townsfolk about their own run-ins with the giant fish proving that bagging the beast is an impossible task. Despite all this, Lily and Jack attempt to accomplish the impossible.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: The series Bubble Guppies revolves around the underwater adventures of a group of mermaid-like preschoolers who life in the fictional underwater city of Bubbletucky. The episode starts with a sketch of Molly saying "Hi, it's me Molly and it's time for-" only to be stopped by Gil doing the subject of the show. When Gil or Molly says "It's time for Bubble Guppies!", the theme song starts. After the theme song, the Little Fish say the episode's name. Something happens when a character goes to school. After that, the school day begins and the Bubble Guppies say "Good morning, Mr. Grouper!". Later, the remaining Guppie tells Mr. Grouper about what happened earlier. He states "Let's think about it," and the characters discuss the topic. The pop song for the episode then begins.One of the Guppies will go to a shop that mostly focuses on the topic. The owner of the shop will asks questions about what he or she needs. Later, Mr. Grouper comes into the shop and says it's time for lunch, and the "Lunchtime" song plays. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: Wylde Pak
programme.desc: On their way back from Lake World, the Wylde Paks get stuck in a massive traffic jam. The situation gets so dire that all the drivers have no choice but to set up camp - a camp that quickly turns into its own, self-governing, rudimentary society. Struggling with a vacuum of power, Jack is chosen as their reluctant leader, but he's determined to usher them into peace. Meanwhile, Lily catches feelings for a boy in a nearby car, but because the boy's dad and Will have serious road rage beef, their romance is forbidden. // Desperate to leave their mark on Canyon Valley, Jack and Lily set out to capture the great beast of Canyon Valley Lake - a giant fish that has menaced the town for years. After being swallowed whole multiple times, Lily and Jack realize they must take a different approach, but then they hear horror stories from other townsfolk about their own run-ins with the giant fish proving that bagging the beast is an impossible task. Despite all this, Lily and Jack attempt to accomplish the impossible.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.
